rootCause.description: Effect B used useRef(false) flipped to true on its first invocation to skip the mount run. Under React 18 StrictMode (dev), the same effect is invoked twice on a single real mount (mount -> cleanup -> mount, same component instance, refs NOT reset between passes). First pass: ref false -> set true, skip. Second pass: ref already true -> skip condition no longer met -> fires a real, spurious fetch even though `refresh` never actually changed.
rootCause.fix: Replaced the 'is this the first run' flag with a comparison against the last synced `refresh` value (useRef(refresh) + `if (lastSyncedRefresh.current === refresh) return;`). Robust to any number of effect invocations with an unchanged dependency value (StrictMode included), identical observable behavior for the real case (a genuine save incrementing `refresh`).
rootCause.verificationDescription: temporarily reverted the fix, ran the new test — it failed (timeout waiting for 2 calls, got 3); restored the fix — test passes again
